question: Nice to meet you. I was thinking while looking at Iva-chan that I'd like to see genderswapped versions of the Straw Hats. You don't think you could draw them for me? Please do it . Pen Name: TOMO. M
answer: Sure. They become different. Luffy: I'll eat salad and become the Pirate Queen! Zoro: Three swords? I can't, that'd break my teeth. Nami: I'm asking ya - who's the navigator on this ship? Usopp: I think I'll die if I go to that island. Sanji: I only do sweets. Chopper: Mr. Doctooor! Oh, that's me! Robin: That was cruel yo. Franky: Am I super this week? Brook: ? [note: Except for Luffy (partly), Zoro and Sanji, they all say their own catchphrases, but modified to be extremely feminine/masculine.]
